capabilities: , Browse book notes as cover cards
extras: Data sources (WeRead/Douban) are undocumented endpoints and may change or rate-limit. Metadata coverage for English books is limited.
problem: Users lack a visual way to organize book notes and must manually gather covers and metadata for their reading list.

relations.evidence: Search WeRead by title and write the cover, author, publisher, description and rating into the note with one click.
Optionally enrich the note from Douban with ISBN, page count, publication year and publisher.

summary: A cover shelf plugin that displays book notes visually and fetches metadata and covers from WeRead and Douban.
